title: MAG Z890 TOMAHAWK WIFI
description: The MAG Z890 TOMAHAWK WIFI Intel LGA 1851 gaming motherboard delivers cutting-edge connectivity, including Wi-Fi 7, 5G LAN, Thunderbolt 4, PCIe 5.0, and M.2 Gen5. Designed for AI-PCs and EZ DIY, it’s an ideal Z890 ATX motherboard for Intel Core Ultra CPU.
